kind: Independent supplemental source-only resource ownership audit; supersedes earlier no-blocker conclusion for complete local reservation
verdict: Two concrete local resource reservation blockers. No native/RSS guarantee or actual tests. Arithmetic/data-only portions were previously reviewed, but mandatory local full-run lease is incomplete.

blockers.finding: The comparison includes heap + run_quote.requested_bytes but mandatory capture reserver obtains only heap. Runner requests q through optional process-global memory_reserver_v1(); memory::reserve_v1(None) returns Ok(None), then executor/hashes/logit rows/scratch allocate. Thus valid standalone use with a real capture/disk reserver and no process-global callback has no lease for q. reserved_bytes is an arithmetic number, not evidence that an owned reservation exists.
blockers.minimal_counterexample: Use supplied capture reserver backed by a ledger, leave global reserver unset (default), choose otherwise valid fixture and cap >= heap+q. Ledger receives only capture heap although actual run owns q executor/retained/scratch.
blockers.required_contract: Capture must acquire/hold q in its mandatory lease, or pass and retain a required run lease from the same explicit ledger before drive. Define avoiding optional/global double accounting; keep retained run reservation alive through capture and builder use.

blockers.finding: The first mandatory RAM acquisition occurs after context_hash and class_id. Context CanonicalWriter allocates, and class_id layout_digest Borsh-serializes layout vectors. This is bounded by cheap format limits but still allocates before actual RAM permission and before max_live_heap rejection. Work charges do not reserve RAM.
blockers.minimal_counterexample: A legal metadata-sized layout or a near-format-cap mismatching delivered layout causes layout serialization allocation even if configured max_live_heap is too small or the reserver would deny. Allocation occurs before either denial can run.
blockers.required_contract: Compute a checked cheap memory quote using already fixed work IDs and lengths, acquire its mandatory guard first, then hash/encode/compare. Include layout serialization and context writer scratch explicitly; a small independently acquired preflight guard also suffices.

owner_mapping.capture_records_and_leaves: Exact capacity vectors are represented by max_records*sizeof(Record), max_step_leaves*sizeof(Leaf). vec_exact rejects capacity different from request. Inline Vec headers and Build/Rc/RefCell/closure/Shape/errors are not independently enumerated; these fit only an undocumented fixed allowance.
owner_mapping.capture_program_times_four: Plausibly canonical space.program().encode writer capacity/growth plus class/layout metadata scratch, but the term is not documented as a proved bound. Expected class program may be unrelated to original space until the post-lease join; allocation order is the concrete blocker above.
owner_mapping.capture_material_times_four: Plausible collector-owned narrow canonical leaf decode to i128: a <=M-byte four-byte leaf expands to <=4*M; decoded vector is dropped before separate leaf rehash. Wide decode expands <=2*M. Other run leaf/i128/preimage/hash-writer owners belong in run q and must not be mistaken for this same allowance.
owner_mapping.capture_65536: Current layout format permits <=8192+64 tile entries; context/layout Borsh/writer/headers and 4096-byte stack chunks need explicit lifetime breakdown if this is claimed as a logical bound. Generic slack alone is not native or RSS evidence.
owner_mapping.builder_trees: Uses existing tir_full_tree_storage_need_v1 for step tree, every row tile tree, and row tree. Helper explicitly counts Option<Hash64> backing, levels headers, construction hash vector and 16KiB fixed allowance. Outer tile_trees/roots headers and transient hashes must be assigned to these terms; no independent measured footprint.
owner_mapping.builder_trace_frames_times_1024: Must cover pending Vec<Task>, BTreeSet<Task>, BTreeSet<u64>/BTreeSet<u32>, exported steps vector and shape/index Vec temporaries. Cardinalities are capped by trace frames; 1024 is generous for current keys but no node-layout derivation is supplied. It should be documented/typed-accounted rather than asserted allocator-independent.
owner_mapping.builder_material_times_four: Covers coexisting encoded operand/preimage/target/proof data plus dynamic headers and temporary authenticator material only if source_auth/metadata/provider owners stay separate. Per-leaf bound includes 64 header bytes; range siblings at most 128 hashes each. Source params authenticate against original artifact.
owner_mapping.builder_claim_times_two: Covers one current i128 claim and one visit/export scratch by convention. It does not bound an arbitrary number of retained claim() exports or reentrant callback copies.
owner_mapping.builder_provider_scratch: Explicit mandatory local provider scratch contract; unknown scratch refuses before fetch and failed attempted quote remains charged. It is not enforced against arbitrary provider implementations allocating outside their declared contract.
owner_mapping.builder_metadata_floor: Program*512 and layer-dependent params/state terms are a local declaration floor, not an independently proved bound for every legacy decode/validation/range/clone path. source_auth/signature/retained_record declarations remain distinct owner obligations.

independent_cap_combinations: max_claim_bytes > max_material_bytes is not by itself an internal one-call overrun: uncommitted claims reserve/check 16*n <= C; builder includes 2*C independently; canonical capture leaf decode uses 4*M regardless of C. No new blocker based only on C>M was found.
max_material/max_trace/max_provider scratch are independent: cannot replace 2*C or provider/source auth terms by a generic M multiple without preserving all independent terms.

Allocator capacity growth is avoided for vec_exact-owned output vectors; existing BTreeSet/collect/tree/header growth requires actual implementation-specific reasoning or capped arenas. Arithmetic byte charges do not enforce physical allocator/RSS behavior.

export_and_legacy_freeze_contract_gap.finding: binding() and claim() return owned allocations with no lease carried by the export and no single-live export restriction. visit callback may clone/retain every claim (explicitly external owner in module docs). Signature/retained_record bytes are merely nonzero, not joined to actual capacities or prep record limits. Builder Drop releases its lease although an independently frozen record may outlive it. Therefore the adapter does not itself reserve or bound arbitrary caller retention/full legacy freeze.
export_and_legacy_freeze_contract_gap.classification: Explicit caller/integration obligation; blocker to claiming this local adapter by itself covers the full legacy record/signature/Node handoff. Not a demand that pure data DTO APIs acquire native authority.
export_and_legacy_freeze_contract_gap.required_integration: Before collecting all claims acquire independent capacity-aware retained record + scratch/validation/signature reservations, carry guard to last record/Node owner, and bind actual lengths/capacities. Alternatively use guarded borrowed/single-live exports. Document claim/binding export owner as explicitly as visit/stream_borsh.
export_and_legacy_freeze_contract_gap.legacy_hash_detail: PrototypePanelRecord::hash uses streaming HashWriter, so a full Borsh encoding buffer is not inherently required. freeze_record validates/rederives binding before record_heap check, so its decoder/layout workspace needs an already acquired separate owner; post-hoc max_record_heap is a bound check, not a lease.
export_and_legacy_freeze_contract_gap.current_tests: exercise retains claims Vec<Vec<i128>>, an encoded stream Vec and temporary borsh::to_vec output together; no-op RAM guards do not prove this envelope. Test owner fields are large constants, not measured or actual-capacity checked.
